name: Reiser Warm
use: The personal template. Warm-neutral field, charcoal ink, a single coral accent, built on 60-30-10. Not brand-facing — do not mix with ANA Blue in one file.

geometry.radius_note: deck-build takes one radius; the template's own panels run 2.0-26.0pt by role. See references/grid.md.

discipline: Warm neutral field carries roughly 60% of the surface; charcoal ink plus one supporting tint carries 30%; coral appears on about 10% and never more. Low contrast between the neutrals, high contrast between ink and field. No shadows, no coloured backgrounds beyond the neutral family. accent_ink is charcoal rather than the usual white, because coral is a mid-tone.
never: coral #CC785C as text on the cream field (2.92:1 — fails at every size; use #9D5C47)
white text on a coral fill (3.28:1 — use charcoal #1F1E1D at 5.08:1)
sage mist #B3CBC1 or stone #D4D0C9 as text on any neutral (1.53:1 and 1.37:1)
more than one accent colour on a page
中文 without font.ea set to 微軟正黑體
the dark deck-build styles — dark-tech, data-journalism, chalkboard
mixing this identity with ANA Blue in one file

proportions.note: coral is fill-only, so the accent band never carries type; #9D5C47 is its text-safe stand-in.
